name: pg_anyfk
abstract: Foreign keys for the elements of an array column
description: Postgres has no syntax for constraining the values inside an array column: a FOREIGN KEY constrains the whole column value, not the elements. pg_anyfk enforces the reference, rejecting elements with no matching parent row and protecting the referenced row from deletion, with an on_delete mode that either refuses the delete or removes the key from every array holding it.
